messages:
Ravi Menon: Quick coordination for candidate Priya K.'s onsite Fri Sep 10. Window 9:30am-1:00pm PT. Needs silent workspace between interviews, vegetarian meal (no dairy), and a loaner Chromebook for web UI exercise. Can we confirm loaner and greeter?

Sara Li: I can cover 10:00-10:45 panel. Will add dietary notes.

Front Desk: We can assign Greeter Maya at South Lobby 9:15am. Visitor badge request created BR-20344.

Ravi Menon: Great. Loaner note: Chromebook tag C-101 is in inventory but needs imaging. IT will need 24h. Can someone confirm pickup?

People Ops Bot: Loaner request queued (LN-789). Imaging window booked Thurs 6pm. Reminder created for pickup Fri 8:45am.

Sara Li: I'll pick up Chromebook if Ops confirms imaging done. :thumbsup: Also note: candidate prefers a low-scent environment. Facility please reduce cleaning fog on that floor.

Front Desk: Noted. We'll post a "low-scent" notice and reserve Quiet Room A beside panel rooms.

Ravi Menon: Travel stipends: policy is up to $200 local. Priya prefers cab; we'll process via ACH. Sara, please ask candidate to email receipts to hiring-expenses@redwood.com.

Sara Li: Will do and send final itinerary + contact number by EOD.

People Ops Bot: Checklist: (1) IT image Chromebook C-101 (2) Greeter Maya confirmed (3) Quiet Room A reserved (4) Badge BR-20344 pending. React with :white_check_mark: when tasks complete.
